bills.summary_ai: This bill expands veterinary service access by allowing foreign-educated veterinarians to practice under temporary permits and enables telehealth establishment of veterinarian-client-patient relationships for urgent conditions. While primarily focused on veterinarians, it affects the paraprofessional workforce by potentially expanding the scope of services available and may influence how veterinary teams deliver care through telehealth platforms.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)

bills.title: An Act Concerning Credit Cards And Health And Veterinary Care Services.
bills.summary_ai: This bill restricts veterinary care providers from advertising, promoting, or accepting medical credit cards for services, and requires disclosure of credit card information to consumers. It directly impacts veterinary paraprofessionals who work in clinical settings where payment methods and financial practices are established.
categories: Veterinary Technicians (CVT, RVT, LVT, vet tech)
